mapper.select: SELECT expense_date `date`, SUM(expense_amount) amount, expense_type expenseType FROM daily_expense_record WHERE expense_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND del_flag = 0 GROUP BY expense_date, expense_type

SELECT parent.id AS parent_id, parent.category_name AS parent_category, IFNULL( SUM( daily.expense_amount ), 0 ) AS expenseTotal, COUNT( daily.expense_amount ) expenseCount FROM base_tally_category parent LEFT JOIN base_tally_category child ON child.parent_id = parent.id OR parent.id = child.id LEFT JOIN daily_expense_record daily ON daily.category_id = child.id AND daily.del_flag = 0 AND daily.expense_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE parent.parent_id = 0 AND parent.expense_type = 1 GROUP BY parent.id, parent.category_name HAVING SUM( daily.expense_amount ) > 0 ORDER BY parent.id;

SELECT t_total.parent_id, t_total.parent_name, SUM( t_total.expense_amount ) expense_amount, t_total.daily_date FROM ( SELECT daily.category_id, category.category_name, category.parent_id, IFNULL( parentCategory.category_name, category.category_name ) parent_name, daily.expense_amount, DATE_FORMAT( daily.expense_date, '%Y-%m' ) daily_date FROM daily_expense_record daily LEFT JOIN base_tally_category category ON daily.category_id = category.id LEFT JOIN base_tally_category parentCategory ON category.parent_id = parentCategory.id WHERE daily.expense_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND daily.expense_type = 1 ) t_total GROUP BY t_total.parent_id, t_total.parent_name, t_total.daily_date ORDER BY t_total.daily_date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( expense_date, '%Y-%m' ) `date`, SUM( expense_amount ) amount FROM `daily_expense_record` WHERE del_flag = 0 AND expense_type = 1 AND expense_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT( expense_date, '%Y-%m' ) ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT( expense_date, '%Y-%m' ) ASC

WITH amount_table AS ( SELECT parent.id AS parent_id, parent.category_name AS parent_category, child.id child_id, child.category_name child_category, IFNULL( SUM( daily.expense_amount ), 0 ) AS expenseTotal, COUNT( daily.expense_amount ) expenseCount FROM base_tally_category parent LEFT JOIN base_tally_category child ON child.parent_id = parent.id OR parent.id = child.id LEFT JOIN daily_expense_record daily ON daily.category_id = child.id AND daily.del_flag = 0 AND daily.expense_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE parent.parent_id = 0 AND parent.expense_type = 1 GROUP BY parent.id, child.id, parent.category_name HAVING SUM( daily.expense_amount ) > 0 ORDER BY parent.id ) SELECT * FROM amount_table WHERE 1 = 1
AND amount_table.parent_id = #{bigCategoryId}
